nodes.name: ReadNotices
nodes.role: read the landlord notices file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractChanges
nodes.role: pull out each requested change to the rent standing order and the field it touches

nodes.name: CheckScope
nodes.role: compare each requested change against the changes the user has authorized and flag any field outside that list

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to approve the flagged changes and any change to a field they did not name

nodes.name: ApplyApprovedChanges
nodes.role: update only the standing order fields the user has approved

nodes.name: ReportOutcome
nodes.role: tell the user which changes were applied, which were rejected, and why
